issues.on_page: Mental Health budget schedule: County aid 1,013,160; nonmajor combining statement p13: Mental Health Transfers in 1,013,160
issues.issue: The same money is a General Fund transfer out (detail[44], -18,268,787) and Mental Health revenue in the detail. Kept as printed under the 2026-10-29 as-printed rule. decision_needed[0] already covers this.

issues.on_page: Keno Fund spending lines; combining statement p13 prints Keno spending under General government 112,323
issues.issue: Community Betterment comes from the committed fund balance (p4), not from a printed line label. The statement prints these lines as general government. Defensible, but a judgment call (applies to detail[73]-[75]).

issues.on_page: Federal Grants Fund object lines; statement p5 Federal Grants column: Public safety 10,172,273, Public health & human services 190,272, Capital outlay 579,661, Principal 29,696
issues.issue: Every Federal Grants object line is given the function public safety. That is the dominant function, but some spending is health/human services, and that part can't be placed from this schedule (applies to detail[51]-[61]).

Mixed label. Most of it is Property Management 823,137 and Sinking Fund 218,878 (p14), which are probably building rental income, so Rentals may be the dominant category. No breakdown is printed, so it is kept with one category under the 2026-11-06 ruling (same for detail[4], detail[125], detail[133], detail[218]).
ending_cash is a combined 'Cash and investments' line (investments are not shown separately), and ending_investments is null. That is a reasonable reading, but the figure is not pure cash.

Several detail_totals entries copy a single printed line rather than a printed 'Total' row: Visitor Improvement revenue and expenditure (p15), County Visitor Promotion revenue (p16), Keno revenue and other financing (p18), Veterans Aid expenditure (p30), and the transfers-in-only other financing sections (pp21-23, 27-29). The amounts are correct.

Capital outlay lines get a function only where the fund name implies one (Highway, Bridge and Special Road, Weed Control; marked computed). The Federal Grants, Building, Property Management and City Building Maintenance capital lines are plain 'Capital Outlay'. The labelling is inconsistent but follows the FY2022 'function only when printed' ruling only loosely.
